name: Highspire
description: The royal city of Vael, climbing a granite hill in tiers: Lowtown at the bottom in the smoke, the High Tiers above it in white stone, and the Ember Palace on the crown of the hill. It is colder here than it should be this far south, and it is getting colder. The Regency says the Thornwake is a northern rumour, and has started arresting people who say otherwise.
travel_text: Bells ring the hour from a dozen towers at once, never quite together, and the frost on the cobbles crunches under your boots.

events.text: Two Knife-Guards have a ragged man pinned to a wall. 'Spreading panic,' one of them says. 'He was telling people the river froze at Brightwater.' The man looks at you. The river did freeze at Brightwater.

success.message: You talk fast and sweetly about paperwork, and the guards decide he is more trouble than he is worth. The man is gone before they finish deciding.

fail.message: 'Move along,' says the guard, 'or you can tell us about the weather too.' They march him off up the Stair.

events.text: A fountain in a little square has frozen solid mid-splash, a sculpture of grey ice. Children are sliding on the basin. Something dark is frozen in the middle of it.

success.message: It is a purse, dropped in before the freeze and caught there. You chip it free with a dagger, to loud applause from the children, and give them half.

fail.message: Whatever it is, it is deep in the ice. The children ask you to slide with them, and for a minute you do.

events.text: A bread line runs round three streets in Lowtown, and the bakery at the head of it has a sign that says Closed by order.

success.message: You lean on the clerk guarding the bakery until he remembers a store-room he forgot to declare. The line gets fed. Someone in it starts singing.

fail.message: The clerk calls for the Knives, and you walk away before they come. The line watches you go.

events.text: A Collegium cart has lost a wheel on the Stair, and crates of glassware are sliding off the back one by one.

success.message: You catch the last crate before it goes. The apprentice driving the cart, white with terror, presses a cordial on you from the cargo. 'Nobody counts these. Please don't tell anyone.'

fail.message: The crate bursts on the cobbles in a spray of glass and blue fire. Nobody is hurt. The apprentice bursts into tears.

events.text: On a north-facing wall, frost has grown into the shape of a briar: long curling stems, thorns, even a flower. It is very beautiful, and it is growing while you watch.

success.message: It is the Thornwake's cold, here, two hundred miles south of where it should be. Something in the city has been holding it back, and something is failing.

fail.message: You touch it and it burns like a nettle. Your fingers ache for an hour.

events.text: An old man in a threadbare Order cloak stops you on the Stair and grips your arm. 'They say the Order rode out of Emberhold. Is it true? Are they coming?'

success.message: You tell him yes. He straightens, ten years younger, and presses a battered Order badge into your hand for luck. 'Tell Edric old Ham Fletcher's still standing.'

fail.message: He does not believe you, quite, but he wants to. He wanders off humming the Order's marching song.

sights: a bell tower with frost on the inside of its windows
a lamplighter on a long ladder, lighting lamps at noon because the sky is so dark
a statue of Queen Isolde with fresh candles burning at its feet and a Knife-Guard watching who lights them
the Ember Palace on the crown of the hill, every window lit
a queue outside a coal merchant that does not move
a Collegium magister in blue hurrying past with a frozen bird in a jar
green Regency banners frozen stiff on their poles
a child's chalk drawing of a black briar on a wall, half scrubbed out
